name: Traditional Christmas Pork or Chicken Tamales (Steamed Corn Masa)
brandOrRestaurant: Holiday Mexican Tradition (Christmas Eve / New Year)
whyItWorks: A beloved Western holiday tradition! Steamed ground corn masa is soft, thoroughly cooked, and gentle on digestion. Shredded pork or chicken filling is tender and unbreaded.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Unwrap the corn husk and enjoy the warm steamed tamale with mild red chile sauce.
watchOuts: Ensure red chile sauce is mild and not overly spiced with jalapeños
